title: REQ · BootScene emits characterClick when an NPC is clicked and still plays interact
summary: The character pointerdown handler emits characterClick with the spec id in addition to the interact animation.
description: Context: createCharacter's pointerdown handler returns early when idleKey is missing or interactKey equals idleKey, so any emit placed after those guards would be skipped for characters without a distinct interact animation. Desired behavior: emit characterClick { id: spec.id } first on every click, then run the existing animation logic. Expected result: React always learns of the click. Why: NPCs without interact animations must still be clickable.
acceptance_criteria: Given a character sprite, When its pointerdown listener runs, Then phaserToReact emits characterClick with { id: spec.id }.
Given a character whose interact animation exists, When clicked, Then sprite.play is called with the interact key after the emit.
Given a character with no distinct interact animation, When clicked, Then characterClick is still emitted and no animation change occurs.
technical_constraints: Use phaserToReact already imported in BootScene.ts
